name: Almost Queen
aliases: Almost Queen - A Tribute To Queen

evidence.note: Paramount lists the Oct 3, 2026 show (doors 7, show 8) with The Super 70's Rock Show; stresses harmonies and musical detail.
Tour list shows the band mostly plays seated theaters and performing arts centers.
Another theater describes a concert-style show with costumes and harmonies.

dancing.notes: A ticketed theater concert at The Paramount. Fans mostly watch and sing along to Queen anthems rather than dance.

description: A touring four-piece tribute band that recreates Queen's live shows, with four-part vocal harmonies and costumes.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Rating based on the show format and theater venues, not crowd videos. Socials taken from almostqueen.com.

Directory research 2026-10-04: All current links re-verified from the official site; current description is accurate, so no new one. Logo and two promo photos come from the band's own 'Marketing Assets' page meant for promoters; the live photo is from their gallery, credited there to photographer Mike Vernazza. Skipped header images with big text and gallery photos with photographer watermarks. The site's Bandcamp link is guitarist Steve Leonard's page (steveleonard.bandcamp.com) for the single 'Almost', so it is not recorded as the band's. The tour page currently shows no dates.

logo.alt: Almost Queen logo: a crest with a white phoenix, lions and fairies around the words ALMOST QUEEN, A TRIBUTE TO QUEEN
